m701-feelings.observed_description: A waiting room with four adults on chairs: a woman wrapped in a plaid blanket blowing her nose (sick), a man with arms crossed and a deep frown (angry), a woman with wide eyes and raised palms over a spider on the floor (afraid), and a relaxed smiling man giving a thumbs-up (fine).
m701-feelings.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo.

m704-farm.observed_description: One green field under a blue sky with, from left to right, a black-and-white cow grazing, a brown horse running, a pink pig standing and a white sheep standing. No people.
